known_case.note: Pawan of Handia took Rs 2.90 lakh against his property card and rented a shop (PM interaction, Oct 2021). All 1,020 abadi parcels of Handia were censused via loan_hunter: 0 carried any charge in RoR col 11.

verdict: Official loans are claimed to exist, yet zero charges are registered across every abadi parcel checked — including a full census of a village with a documented loan. The card's loan is not recorded against its title: the collateral function is nominal, not reflected in the land record.
